name: Reel Wave
description: Full-screen WebGL gallery of image columns that loop endlessly and bend into a wave as the page scrolls, with column speed and direction driven by scroll velocity.
contents: Three columns of looping image planes rendered in a fixed full-screen canvas
behavior: Images move with Lenis scroll velocity and wrap around infinitely
Vertex shader bends planes along a cosine curve and stretches them with scroll speed
Columns move at different speeds and opposite directions
Images are cover-fitted in the fragment shader
editableByProps: Images, sizes, gap and number of columns with their positions and speeds
Curve strength, frequency, scroll direction, smoothing and camera distance
Background color, Lenis usage and options, loader visibility

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the image fit or add effects to the picture

fixed: Canvas is fixed to the full viewport and covers the page
Takes over page scrolling with Lenis when includeLenis is true, so it should be the only smooth scroll on the page
Images only move while the page scrolls, so the page needs scroll height or infinite Lenis
